sql_text: WITH hop1 AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_partkey, l_receiptdate - l_shipdate AS transit_days, l_commitdate - o_orderdate AS promised_days, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ), supplier_scores AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit, AVG(promised_days) AS avg_promised, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN transit_days <= promised_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_rate FROM hop1 GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name, ROUND(avg_transit::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_transit_days, ROUND(avg_promised::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND((100.0 * fulfillment_rate)::NUMERIC, 2) AS fulfillment_pct, ROUND(total_revenue::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND( ((fulfillment_rate * 50) + (50.0 / NULLIF(avg_transit, 0)))::NUMERIC, 4 ) AS efficiency_score FROM supplier_scores JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey != n_nationkey ORDER BY efficiency_score ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH hop1 AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_partkey, l_receiptdate - l_shipdate AS transit_days, l_commitdate - o_orderdate AS promised_days, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ), supplier_scores AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit, AVG(promised_days) AS avg_promised, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN transit_days <= promised_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_rate FROM hop1 GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name, ROUND(avg_transit::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_transit_days, ROUND(avg_promised::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND((100.0 * fulfillment_rate)::NUMERIC, 2) AS fulfillment_pct, ROUND(total_revenue::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND( ((fulfillment_rate * 50) + (50.0 / NULLIF(avg_transit, 0)))::NUMERIC, 4 ) AS efficiency_score FROM supplier_scores JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation ON s_nationkey != n_nationkey ORDER BY efficiency_score ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH hop1 AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_partkey, l_receiptdate - l_shipdate AS transit_days, l_commitdate - o_orderdate AS promised_days, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ), supplier_scores AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit, AVG(promised_days) AS avg_promised, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN transit_days <= promised_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_rate FROM hop1 GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name, ROUND(avg_transit::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_transit_days, ROUND(avg_promised::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND((100.0 * fulfillment_rate)::NUMERIC, 2) AS fulfillment_pct, ROUND(total_revenue::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND( ((fulfillment_rate * 50) + (50.0 / NULLIF(avg_transit, 0)))::NUMERIC, 4 ) AS efficiency_score FROM supplier_scores JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey RIGHT JOIN nation ON s_nationkey != n_nationkey ORDER BY efficiency_score ASC LIMIT 1000;

WITH hop1 AS ( SELECT l_orderkey, l_suppkey, l_partkey, l_receiptdate - l_shipdate AS transit_days, l_commitdate - o_orderdate AS promised_days, l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount) AS revenue FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey ), supplier_scores AS ( SELECT l_suppkey, AVG(transit_days) AS avg_transit, AVG(promised_days) AS avg_promised, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN transit_days <= promised_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / COUNT(*) AS fulfillment_rate FROM hop1 GROUP BY l_suppkey ) SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, n_name, ROUND(avg_transit::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_transit_days, ROUND(avg_promised::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_promised_days, ROUND((100.0 * fulfillment_rate)::NUMERIC, 2) AS fulfillment_pct, ROUND(total_revenue::NUMERIC, 2) AS total_revenue, ROUND( ((fulfillment_rate * 50) + (50.0 / NULLIF(avg_transit, 0)))::NUMERIC, 4 ) AS efficiency_score FROM supplier_scores JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey RIGHT JOIN nation ON s_nationkey != n_nationkey ORDER BY efficiency_score DESC LIMIT 1000;

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT l_partkey, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', l_shipdate) AS mo, SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey, mo ), moving_avg AS ( SELECT l_partkey, mo, qty, AVG(qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS ma3, AVG(qty) OVER ( PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS ma6 FROM monthly ) SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_brand, mo, qty, ROUND(ma3::NUMERIC, 2) AS moving_avg_3m, ROUND(ma6::NUMERIC, 2) AS moving_avg_6m FROM moving_avg JOIN part ON l_partkey = p_partkey WHERE mo >= DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY p_partkey, mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo),moving_avg AS (SELECT l_partkey,mo,qty,AVG(qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 11 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma12 FROM monthly) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,ROUND(ma12::NUMERIC,2) AS moving_avg_12m FROM moving_avg JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,LAG(qty,1) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo) AS prev_month_qty FROM monthly JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,LEAD(qty,1) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo) AS next_month_qty FROM monthly JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,SUM(qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo) AS cumulative_qty FROM monthly JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo),stats AS (SELECT l_partkey,mo,qty,AVG(qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey) AS avg_qty FROM monthly) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,ROUND((qty-avg_qty)::NUMERIC,2) AS deviation FROM stats JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY qty DESC) AS demand_rank FROM monthly JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_extendedprice) AS sales FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo),moving_avg AS (SELECT l_partkey,mo,sales,AVG(sales) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ma3_sales FROM monthly) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,sales,ROUND(ma3_sales::NUMERIC,2) AS moving_avg_sales_3m FROM moving_avg JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo),moving_avg AS (SELECT l_partkey,mo,qty,MAX(qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_max FROM monthly) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,rolling_max FROM moving_avg JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;

WITH monthly AS (SELECT l_partkey,DATE_TRUNC('MONTH',l_shipdate) AS mo,SUM(l_quantity) AS qty FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_partkey,mo),moving_avg AS (SELECT l_partkey,mo,qty,MIN(qty) OVER(PARTITION BY l_partkey ORDER BY mo ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_min FROM monthly) SELECT p_partkey,p_name,p_brand,mo,qty,rolling_min FROM moving_avg JOIN part ON l_partkey=p_partkey ORDER BY p_partkey,mo LIMIT 100;
